name: network-info
title: Network Info
description: Local and public IP, gateway latency, DNS, per-interface throughput, the apps using the network, and a download, upload and latency test.
author: black

commands.name: network-info
commands.title: Network Info
commands.description: Local and public IP, gateway latency, DNS, live throughput and the apps with open connections

commands.name: copy-public-ip
commands.title: Copy Public IP
commands.description: Look up the egress address and put it on the clipboard

preferences.name: interfaceScope
preferences.title: Throughput Scope
preferences.description: Which counters the download and upload rates come from. All interfaces sums every non-virtual one; virtual bridges, tunnels and container interfaces are left out either way.

preferences.name: speedInterval
preferences.title: Sample Every
preferences.description: How often the byte counters are read while the view is open.

preferences.name: chartWindow
preferences.title: Chart Window
preferences.description: How much history the throughput sparkline draws. Samples are kept for half an hour regardless.

preferences.name: showGraph
preferences.title: Throughput Chart
preferences.label: Show the throughput sparkline
preferences.description: Draws the download and upload history in the detail pane of the throughput rows.

preferences.name: showPerApp
preferences.title: Active Applications
preferences.label: List the apps with open connections
preferences.description: Runs ss while the view is open. Only sockets this user owns can be attributed to a process name.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: CLI Path
preferences.description: Executable name or full path for the Speedtest CLI. Leave empty to use speedtest from PATH, then ~/.local/bin/speedtest. The official Ookla CLI is preferred; speedtest-cli also works.

scripts.test: tsx test/format.test.ts && tsx test/parse.test.ts && tsx test/rates.test.ts && tsx test/sparkline.test.ts && tsx test/public.test.ts && tsx test/speedtest.test.ts && tsx test/speedtest-cli.test.ts && tsx test/speedtest-run.test.ts && tsx test/speedtest-view.test.ts
